headline: Naomi Ackie talks career at London Film Festival
post:
During a recent Screen Talk at the BFI London Film Festival, actress Naomi Ackie discussed her career, her love for the London film scene, and her experiences working in both smaller U.K. productions and major Hollywood movies. She also spoke about the challenges of portraying Whitney Houston in I Wanna Dance With Somebody and her enjoyment of starring in horror films.

Further updates on her career and projects will follow.

headline: Moon Choi talks Bedford Park and Hollywood crossover
post:
Rising star Moon Choi is navigating a brand new chapter with her acclaimed indie romance "Bedford Park," according to The Hollywood Reporter. The film tells the story of an unfiltered physical therapist and a prickly former wrestler who form an unexpected bond. Choi recently admitted she feels "a bit nervous because I don’t know what to expect" regarding how local audiences will react to the movie's mature themes during its screening at the Busan International Film Festival.

Aside from sharing her new project, Choi is also serving on the festival's main competition jury led by Zhang Yimou. Reflecting on her winding career path from childhood relocations to sharing the stage with her idol Jeon Do-yeon, the actress continues to embrace every fresh challenge.

Sony Pictures Classics plans to release the indie drama in the United States next year. Have you added this emotional new romance to your must-watch list yet? 🎬

#MoonChoi #BedfordPark #FilmFestival
original_title: ‘Bedford Park’ Star Moon Choi Charts Her Own Path Between Korea and Hollywood

headline: Teacher Jacob Myers-Norys reacts to Khloe Kardashian
post:
Remember when Khloe Kardashian left a flirty comment on a teacher's Instagram post? According to E! News, high school teacher Jacob Myers-Norys recently found himself discussed on the season eight premiere of The Kardashians. 

Khloe shared that after she innocently replied to his post, the situation unexpectedly "took off like wildfire." She revealed that she left him on read after receiving multiple direct messages, telling the camera, "Calm down, Yacob." 

Instead of feeling embarrassed, Jacob had a hilarious response on TikTok. He compared the moment to his daily routine, noting that he deals with being "roasted and embarrassed" by teenagers constantly. At least he can proudly say he made it onto the famous show! 

Would you laugh it off if a celebrity talked about you on TV?

#TheKardashians #KhloeKardashian #RealityTV
original_title: Teacher Reacts to Khloe Kardashian Making Fun of Him for Flirting
